heading: INT. DECOMMISSIONED PLANETARIUM - CORPORATE RETREAT - DAY

units.text: INT. DECOMMISSIONED PLANETARIUM - CORPORATE RETREAT - DAY
A great hollow dome, peeling and blue, its star projector slumped like a dead insect in the center of the floor.
Folding chairs form a circle beneath a painted Milky Way.
A banner reads TEAM ASCENT.
LORRAINE FAIRWEATHER (50s, facilitator, silk scarf, voice made of honey) stands beside an easel.
GIDEON OKPARA (40s, sales director, ironed jeans) slouches on a chair, ankle on knee.
MIKA TANAKA-BELL (late 20s, analyst, sweating through a blazer) clutches a coffee.
SEBASTIAN VOGT (60s, CFO, wire spectacles) sits as if posing for a portrait.
PERPETUA ALVAREZ (30s, HR, lanyard, tight smile) guards the exit.
She uncaps a marker and draws a star on the easel.
Gideon. What is the one word that describes your role?
units.name: LORRAINE

units.text: Closer.
units.name: GIDEON

units.text: Mika?
units.name: LORRAINE

units.text: Um. Fine?
units.name: MIKA

units.text: Be bolder, Mika.
units.name: LORRAINE

units.text: Fine... ly bolder?
units.name: MIKA

units.text: Sebastian removes his spectacles and polishes them.
Lorraine, when does the feedback session begin?
units.name: SEBASTIAN

units.text: That is the session, Sebastian.
units.name: LORRAINE

units.text: Ah.
units.name: SEBASTIAN

units.text: Perpetua taps her watch.
Nobody notices.
Now. Each of you will name the person on your left and say one true thing.
units.name: LORRAINE

units.text: Mika turns toward Gideon.
Gideon turns toward Sebastian.
Sebastian turns toward Perpetua.
Perpetua turns toward Lorraine, who, in turn, faces Mika.
The circle closes.
Sebastian. You sign my expenses without reading them.
units.name: GIDEON

units.text: Perpetua. You have been planning your resignation for eleven weeks.
units.name: SEBASTIAN

units.text: Lorraine. This planetarium has no heat.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Mika. You are the best of us.
units.name: LORRAINE

units.text: Mika bursts into tears, then into laughter.
Gideon cracks first.
Then Sebastian, a dry wheeze.
Perpetua covers her mouth.
Even Lorraine drops her marker.
The dome picks up their noise and throws it back, a hundred times larger, until they are laughing at the stars.
Gideon, I think I love you all.
units.name: MIKA

units.text: Careful, Mika. That's how they get you.
units.name: GIDEON
